8078.title: ACP local image reads lose their image classification
8078.rootCauseOneLine: ACP read classification always emits fileRead, so image paths never select the existing image preview renderer.
8078.proposedFix: Classify resolved absolute local image paths as the existing imageView kind within ACP read translation, preserving ordinary reads and URLs.
8078.caveats: Repeated translator/assembler tests, not a live provider or browser reproduction. No user runtime data accessed.
